*, ::before, ::after { margin: 0px; padding: 0px; box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; } :root { --bg: #030d1a; --bg2: #050f22; --blue: #1a6fff; --blue-bright: #4d9fff; --cyan: #00d4ff; --green: #00e676; --red: #ff3d3d; --text: #ffffff; --text-dim: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); --text-muted: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); --border: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); --card: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); --ease: cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: var(--bg); font-family: Rajdhani, "Noto Sans Thai", sans-serif; color: var(--text); overflow: hidden; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; } .screen { position: absolute; inset: 0px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; overflow: hidden auto; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transform: translateX(30px); transition: opacity 0.45s var(--ease), transform 0.45s var(--ease); padding-bottom: 40px; } .screen.active { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; transform: translateX(0px); } .screen.exit-left { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-30px); pointer-events: none; } .screen::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 3px; } .screen::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 4px; } .bg-layer { position: fixed; inset: 0px; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 10%, rgba(26,111,255,0.15) 0%, transparent 55%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 80%, rgba(0,100,200,0.12) 0%, transparent 55%), var(--bg); } .pyramid { position: fixed; top: 15%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 300px; height: 280px; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; opacity: 0.06; } .pyramid svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; } .app-header { position: relative; z-index: 2; text-align: center; padding: 48px 24px 24px; width: 100%; } .app-header h1 { font-family: Orbitron, monospace; font-size: clamp(22px, 6vw, 30px); font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 2px; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); margin-bottom: 6px; } .app-header .sub { font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--blue-bright); font-weight: 400; opacity: 0.8; } #screen-lang { justify-content: center; gap: 0px; } .lang-hero { position: relative; z-index: 2; text-align: center; padding: 0px 32px 40px; width: 100%; } .lang-hero .big-title { font-size: clamp(30px, 9vw, 48px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; margin-bottom: 16px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(255, 255, 255) 0%, rgb(160, 196, 255) 60%, rgb(111, 163, 255) 100%) text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; } .lang-hero .desc { color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 10px; } .lang-hero .bullets { list-style: none; color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 15px; text-align: left; display: inline-block; margin-bottom: 40px; } .lang-hero .bullets li::before { content: "• "; color: var(--blue-bright); } .lang-hero .bullets li { margin-bottom: 6px; } .lang-grid { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 40px; } .lang-btn { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 18px 28px; background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s var(--ease); min-width: 100px; } .lang-btn:hover, .lang-btn.sel { background: rgba(26, 111, 255, 0.15); border-color: var(--blue); box-shadow: rgba(26, 111, 255, 0.2) 0px 0px 24px; transform: translateY(-2px); } .lang-btn .flag { font-size: 36px; } .lang-btn .lang-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); } .btn-login { width: calc(100% - 48px); max-width: 400px; padding: 18px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; border-radius: 50px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(26, 111, 255), rgb(0, 68, 204)); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: Orbitron, monospace; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s var(--ease); box-shadow: rgba(26, 111, 255, 0.4) 0px 8px 32px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .btn-login::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0px; background: linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12), transparent); border-radius: 50px; } .btn-login:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: rgba(26, 111, 255, 0.6) 0px 16px 48px; } .btn-login:active { transform: translateY(0px); } #screen-sub { padding-top: 0px; } .sub-body { position: relative; z-index: 2; width: 100%; max-width: 460px; padding: 0px 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; } .field-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7); margin-bottom: 8px; } .neon-input { width: 100%; padding: 16px 20px; background: rgba(26, 111, 255, 0.08); border: 1.5px solid rgba(26, 111, 255, 0.35); border-radius: 12px; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: Rajdhani, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 2px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s; } .neon-input:focus { border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.2) 0px 0px 20px; } .validity-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .led { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); transition: 0.4s; flex-shrink: 0; } .led.green { background: var(--green); border-color: rgb(0, 255, 136); box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--green), 0 0 32px rgba(0,230,118,0.4); } .led.red { background: var(--red); border-color: rgb(255, 102, 102); box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--red), 0 0 32px rgba(255,61,61,0.4); } .btn-check { padding: 12px 24px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: Rajdhani, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.3s; } .btn-check:hover { background: rgba(26, 111, 255, 0.2); border-color: var(--blue); } .history-box { background: rgba(26, 111, 255, 0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(26, 111, 255, 0.2); border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; min-height: 120px; max-height: 220px; overflow-y: auto; } .history-box::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 3px; } .history-box::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); border-radius: 4px; } .history-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: 12px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); } .history-empty { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; text-align: center; padding: 20px 0px; } .history-item { padding: 10px 12px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; border-left: 3px solid var(--blue); } .history-item .hi-type { font-size: 10px;
